prompt_text: Who is the best AI marketing agency in Los Angeles?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” AI marketing agency in Los Angeles — the right partner depends on your goals, budget, industry, channels, and whether you want consulting, hands‑on campaign execution, or AI product development. I can, however, help you find the best fit. A quick overview to get started:

What to tell me so I can recommend specific agencies
- Your primary goal (brand awareness, e‑commerce growth, lead generation, CRM/personalization, ad automation, content generation, etc.)
- Channels you care about (paid search, social, programmatic, email, site personalization, creative)
- Monthly/annual marketing budget
- Company size and vertical (B2C e‑commerce, B2B SaaS, entertainment, CPG…)
- Preference: boutique specialist vs. large integrated agency
- Timeline and KPIs

LA agencies and networks known for data/AI-driven marketing (good places to start)
- Wpromote (El Segundo) — performance marketing with strong programmatic/automation capabilities for midmarket and enterprise.
- Merkle (Dentsu) — large CRM/data-driven agency; good for enterprise personalization, data engineering and identity work.
- Epsilon — enterprise-level CRM and data/machine-learning personalization.
- R/GA — full-service digital agency with strong tech and AI-enabled creative capabilities.
- Hawke Media (Santa Monica) — growth marketing and fractional CMO services, uses AI tools for ecommerce and performance clients.
- Brainlabs — data-driven, experimentation- and automation-focused (has U.S. offices including LA market coverage).

How to evaluate and compare them (quick checklist)
- Case studies showing measurable results for businesses like yours
- Proven AI use (not just buzzwords): model training, A/B/n testing automation, real-time personalization, creative optimization
- Data & privacy capabilities: first‑party data strategy, identity resolution, compliance
- Tech stack & integrations: support for your ad platforms, CDP, analytics, e‑commerce platform
- Team seniority: data scientists / ML engineers + strategists + creative
- Transparent measurement and reporting (incrementality, lift studies)

Suggested questions to ask agencies during vetting
- Can you show a case study where AI/ML materially improved ROI? What were the KPIs and lift?
- What models or automation tools do you build vs. buy?
- How do you handle data security, privacy, and consent?
- Who will own the models and data after engagement ends?
- What is the onboarding timeline and expected milestones?

If you want, tell me the details above and I’ll shortlist 3–5 LA agencies matched to your needs and include starter outreach messages and evaluation notes. Which goals and budget range should I use?
